- 15:20 — The incident is closed after monitoring confirms stable error rates.

citations.text: A full charge takes about 75 minutes with the supplied 65 W charger. Do not charge the battery below 0 °C. The battery indicator shows four LEDs; a single blinking LED means the charge is below 25%.
